fact: The Ministry of Cadre de Vie says a 21 May 2026 meeting of ANAT, EDENMAP and others agreed a shared vision and guidelines to continue implementing a national strategy to standardise street and door addressing across the territory.

The Council of Ministers on 22 April 2026 authorised a mission with a specialist firm to start a digital, geolocated, participatory addressing system first in Abomey-Calavi, Cotonou, Ouidah, Porto-Novo, Sèmè-Podji and Parakou, under a national addressing strategy.

Fraternité reports the 22 April 2026 Council of Ministers decision to draw up a national addressing strategy and to start a digital, geolocated system in six named communes of Grand-Nokoué and Parakou.
